statements.t: We now expect to meet or exceed our initial $60 million cost-savings objective by year-end, and we continue to pursue additional productivity, capacity consolidation, and cost reduction opportunities.
Our M&A pipeline remains active, and we will stay disciplined, pursuing opportunities that strengthen our core businesses, expand our value-added portfolio, and meet our return criteria . ”
Our full year 2026 outlook remains unchanged.
We continue to expect overall industry unit demand for the year to be slightly down in each of our segments based on our sales mix.
While we have mechanisms to offset these costs, energy and transportation are expected to remain elevated for the balance of the year.
Demand tied to new residential construction is expected to remain challenging, while stabilization across most of our other end markets should partially offset that pressure.
Despite these conditions, we expect to continue outperforming our markets through share gains, growth in new and value-added products, and continued execution of our cost-out initiatives.
In addition, initial stocking orders, upgraded manufacturing capacity, and expanded distribution are expected to support continued momentum in our Deckorators’ Surestone business.

These statements, including statements regarding our 2026 outlook, cost-savings objectives, capital allocation, the pending Apache Products acquisition, expected conversion of working capital, and long-term targets, are based on management’s beliefs, assumptions, current expectations, estimates and projections about the markets we serve, the economy and the Company itself.

We have not provided a quantitative reconciliation of the forward-looking adjusted EBITDA margin target to the most directly comparable GAAP measure because certain reconciling items and certain discrete tax items cannot be reasonably predicted due to the long-term nature of this target and the inherent variability and uncertainty of such items.

dropped.t: We are actively managing these short-term disruptions while investing in initiatives that will improve our margin profile and drive above-market growth over the long term.
We remain focused on the factors under our control and we are on track to deliver the remaining $25 million or more from our initial $60 million cost out program by year end.
We will continue to make these investments in a targeted manner, while returning more of our free cash flow to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.

risks.t: the following: fluctuations in currency and inflation
fluctuations in the price of lumber
adverse or unusual weather conditions
adverse economic conditions in the markets we serve
changes in tariffs, import/export regulations, and other trade policies, including the timing and amount of tariff refunds
concentration of sales to customers
the success of vertical integration strategies
excess capacity or supply chain challenges
inbound and outbound transportation costs and our ability to pass those costs through to customers
alternatives to replace treated wood products
government regulations, particularly involving environmental and safety regulations
our ability to make successful business acquisitions, cybersecurity breaches, artificial intelligence, and potential pandemics

statements.t: We are actively managing these short-term disruptions while investing in initiatives that will improve our margin profile and drive above-market growth over the long term.
We remain focused on the factors under our control and we are on track to deliver the remaining $25 million or more from our initial $60 million cost out program by year end.

Our full year 2026 outlook remains unchanged.

We continue to expect overall demand for the balance of the year to be toward the lower end of our prior guidance of flat to slightly down unit expectations in each of our segments based on our sales mix.

Input costs, primarily energy and transportation, are expected to remain elevated, and while we have mechanisms to offset these costs, we expect recovery to be gradual through the remainder of the year.
In addition, initial stocking orders, upgraded manufacturing capacity, and expanded distribution are expected to support continued momentum in our Deckorators’ Surestone business.
